# Information_Generation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The stage in active sensing where observations are synthesized into new, task-relevant information beyond the original measurements. It is essential for iNEST to compute in-network and for TCC to derive topology-aware insights without centralized processing.
